profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Full Stack Developer at Honorlock | Passionate about Education and Creating Opportunities for Learners

🚀 Leveraging over 10 years of development expertise to empower institutions and organizations in maintaining academic integrity and creating opportunities for learners. Author of the New York State Distance Learning Collaboration Course Catalog.

🌐 Technology Enthusiast: Proficient in a myriad of technologies, with a particular fondness for Laravel. I am a proud Larabelle. https://larabelles.com/about

💡 Problem Solver: Proven ability to independently tackle challenges while also thriving in collaborative team environments. Experienced in both initiating projects from scratch, jumping into legacy applications and seamlessly integrating between applications. 

👥 Team Player: While I excel in a team setting, I am equally adept at independently navigating through complex problem-solving scenarios.

⚙️ Favorite Stack: Specialized in crafting robust solutions using Laravel, VueJS, Tailwind, and MySQL. This dynamic combination encapsulates my preferred development ecosystem.

👨‍💻 Holistic Approach: I believe a developer is defined not just by the technologies they use but by their problem-solving approach, teamwork skills, and the pride they take in their work.

🔧 Problem-solving Mindset: Thrives on challenges and possesses a strategic mindset for approaching and solving complex problems.

🌟 Key Attributes: Adaptable | Collaborative | Innovative | Results-Driven | Committed to Excellence

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Continuing to develop and support the New York State Distance Learning Consortium Course Catalog which is used in New York State to share courses over Distance Learning which provides students with course opportunities that they might not receive in their local school.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Worked with the Ensemble Team to develop the Microsoft Sharepoint and Microsoft Teams plugin that integrates with the Ensemble Application. This allows users to easily publish their Ensemble Videos from within Sharepoint and Teams.

positions.title: Distance Learning Network Specialist
positions.description:
Primary Responsibilities included a variety of different tasks supporting the Distance Learning Service which includes Software Engineering, Database Administration, Video-Conferencing Support, Video Streaming Service Administration, Remote Computer Management, and Learning Management Systems Administration and Development. The focus of this position was to find ways to support and innovate services for our subscribing districts and teachers.

Developed the Course Catalog for the New York State Distance Learning Consortium. This system has been active as the State's Catalog since it's creation in 2014. I have been supporting and expanding it since that time.

positions.title: Microcomputer Technical Assistant
positions.description:
Primary Technical Support for the Hewes Educational Center
Designed and Developed Transitional Passport and Inventory Database
Was hired as a Network Specialist based on performance in this position

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Short-Term Contract position to design and develop plugins for the Moodle LMS (PHP
plugins) and Mahara Portfolio System to be used by school districts in Western New York

Independently designed and developed several plugins including custom reports and time tracking blocks. 

Integrated Moodle’s Gradebook to the Pearson PowerSchool Student Information System
using Pearson’s REST API.
